content_sections.heading: AIIMS Kalyani Senior Resident Vacancy 2026 (Department-wise)
content_sections.text: Category-wise breakup (as stated in the notification): OBC–35, SC–2, ST–6, EWS–8 (Total 51). The notification does not list a separate Unreserved (UR) figure alongside this breakup. Additionally, 4% of total vacancies are horizontally reserved for Persons with Disabilities (PwD–OPH/OL) category, as permissible under the rules. AIIMS Kalyani reserves the right to vary the number of vacancies, including reserved vacancies, as per Government of India rules/requirements.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Kalyani Senior Resident Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: A Postgraduate Medical Degree (MD/MS/DNB) or equivalent in the respective discipline from a recognized University/Institute, as provided under the Residency Scheme. All Residency Scheme terms and conditions apply. Hospital Administration: MD in Hospital Administration, or full-time Master's in Hospital Administration (after MBBS), or DNB in Hospital Administration. Transfusion Medicine & Blood Bank: MD/DNB in Transfusion Medicine or Immunohematology & Blood Transfusion. Trauma & Emergency Medicine: MD/DNB in Emergency Medicine/Orthopedics/General Surgery/Anaesthesiology/General Medicine/Pediatrics. Super-specialty departments: DM/M.Ch/DNB or equivalent in the respective discipline, from a recognized University/Institute under the Residency Scheme. Dentistry: MDS. M.Sc./M.Biotech/M.Stat degree in the concerned subject, and a Ph.D. in the concerned or an allied subject, from a recognized University/Institute. Note: Educational qualifications, age, and experience are all reckoned as on the date this notification was published on the Institute website (24 August 2026). Experience is counted only after obtaining the prescribed qualification.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Kalyani Senior Resident Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: There is no written examination. Selection is based purely on performance in a Personal Interview. Candidates can apply for more than one post/department, filling a separate application form and paying separate fees for each. Applications and documents are verified at the time of reporting for interview; only eligible candidates (as per the eligibility list uploaded on the Institute website) are allowed to appear. A merit list (selected and waiting list) is prepared category-wise (UR/OBC/SC/ST), based on interview performance. If candidates are not found eligible in the advertised category, candidates from other categories may be considered against that category on a temporary basis. Any vacancy arising due to non-joining or resignation by a selected candidate will be offered to candidates from the waiting list, in order of merit. The final result will be displayed on www.aiimskalyani.edu.in. Important: No TA/DA/accommodation will be paid for appearing in the interview. Candidates must join within 15 days of the issue of the Offer of Engagement.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Kalyani Senior Resident Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the online application portal: https://forms.gle/975WxZFkcza9Mi6w9 Before starting, keep the following ready as scanned files: all certificates (PDF), a scanned photograph (image file), a scanned signature (image file), and a scanned payment receipt (PDF). Fill in the application form, selecting your preferred department(s) and choice of online/offline interview mode – this choice is final and cannot be changed later. Submit the online application on or before 10 September 2026, 5:00 PM . No hard copy of the application is accepted at this stage. The joining link (for those opting for the online interview) will be shared with eligible candidates before the interview date; the eligibility list will be uploaded on the Institute website. On the day of the interview, bring the completed application in the prescribed format along with self-attested copies of all certificates/documents supporting age, educational qualification, and experience. Important: To apply for more than one post, candidates must fill a separate application and pay separate application fees for each post. No personal communication will be made regarding eligibility – check the Institute website for the eligibility list.

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions
content_sections.text: Fee is payable via NEFT in favour of "AIIMS KALYANI INTERNAL RESOURCES ACCOUNT", A/c No. 41277688529, IFSC SBIN0063963, State Bank of India, AIIMS Kalyani Branch. Fee once remitted is non-refundable under any circumstances; applications without the prescribed fee will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q1. How many Senior Resident posts has AIIMS Kalyani notified in 2026?
faq.answer: AIIMS Kalyani has notified 51 posts across 20 departments, including Anaesthesia (11), Radio Diagnosis (7), Ophthalmology (5), and others.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The online application closes on 10 September 2026 at 5:00 PM. No hard copy is accepted at the application stage.

faq.question: Q3. When is the interview for AIIMS Kalyani Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The hybrid (online and offline) interview will be held on 29–30 September 2026, from 9:30 AM, at AIIMS Kalyani.

faq.question: Q4. Is there a written exam for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, selection is based purely on performance in a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay scale for AIIMS Kalyani Senior Resident?
faq.answer: Level 11 of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix plus NPA for medical graduates (equivalent to ₹15,600–39,100 + Grade Pay ₹6,600 under the 6th CPC).

faq.question: Q6. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, it is a tenure post on contract for a maximum of 3 years, as per the Central Residency Scheme.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for AIIMS Kalyani Senior Resident?
faq.answer: Not exceeding 45 years as on the date the notification was published, with relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC, and 10 years for PwD (OPH) candidates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application fee for AIIMS Kalyani Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: ₹1,000 for UR/OBC, ₹500 for SC/ST/EWS, and exempted for PwBD candidates, payable via NEFT.
